Owing to their immunosup- pressant effect, giving corticosteroids in doses greater than those required for physiological replacement therapy is associated with increased susceptibility to infection, aggravation of existing in- fection, and activation of latent infection. An additional problem is that the anti-inflammatory effect of corticosteroids may mask symptoms until the infection has progressed to an advanced stage; the altered response of the body may also permit the bi- zarre spread of infections, frequently in aberrant forms, such as disseminated parasitic infections.
